name: XXX Talent
source:
In this choice-based adult visual novel you play Frank, a bully by his own admission who, after living a life of hardship and poor choices, agrees to do a job he believes to be degrading and boring, and finds himself in paradise. Frank in fact becomes the handyman in an apartment building at the disposal of the beautiful participants in a reality show: Kayla... Ikaru... Alexandra... Jessika... Will you be able to satisfy all their needs?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1922030/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在这部基于选择的成人视觉小说中，你扮演弗兰克，他自己承认是一个恶霸，在经历了艰苦的生活和糟糕的选择后，他同意做一份他认为有辱人格和无聊的工作，并发现自己身处天堂。事实上，弗兰克成为了一栋公寓楼里的勤杂工，为真人秀中美丽的参与者服务：凯拉……伊卡鲁……亚历山德拉……杰西卡……你能满足他们的所有需求吗？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1922030/]Steam[/url]]
